vocabulary_trigger_manual_description: Someone who can manage workflow triggers starts a run.
vocabulary_trigger_schedule_description: The run starts once at a fixed time.
vocabulary_trigger_condition_description: A monitored fact matches a value, such as stock below its minimum.
vocabulary_step_read_description: Get fresh data from a connected system.
vocabulary_step_condition_description: Continue only when a field has a specific value.
vocabulary_step_capability_description: Ask a connected system to make a change. Luma checks your approval rules first.
vocabulary_step_approval_description: Wait for someone who can approve changes to decide on the next action.
vocabulary_step_wait_description: Pause for a fixed time before continuing.
vocabulary_step_verification_description: Read the data again, independently, to confirm the change worked.
vocabulary_step_escalation_description: Stop and hand the run to a person.
vocabulary_step_end_description: Finish the run with a named outcome.
vocabulary_step_code_description: Compute values with TypeScript, run in isolation, when the builder isn’t enough.
vocabulary_subject_order_description: A sales order in a connected shop or ERP.
vocabulary_subject_inventory_position_de: A linked SKU at one inventory location.
vocabulary_subject_purchase_order_descri: A purchase order recorded in Procurement.
vocabulary_step_human_task_description: Assign work, collect evidence and continue when answered.
vocabulary_step_event_wait_description: Wait for a correlated business event within a deadline.
vocabulary_operator_within_tolerance: Stock quantities agree within the allowed tolerance
vocabulary_operator_complete_scan_after_: A successful full read confirmed recovery
vocabulary_operator_oversell_risk: The shop can sell more stock than is available
vocabulary_operator_stale_evidence: The latest evidence is too old to confirm the result
vocabulary_operator_unknown_quantity: A source has not reported its quantity
vocabulary_operator_inconclusive_authori: The authoritative source needs to be confirmed
vocabulary_operator_incomparable_units: The reported units cannot be compared
vocabulary_operator_hard_read_failure: The connection cannot complete a read
vocabulary_operator_retry_window_exhaust: The connection is still failing after repeated checks
vocabulary_operator_unclassified_error: Luma could not identify the read failure
vocabulary_operator_tenant_mismatch: The evidence does not belong to this workspace
vocabulary_operator_progress_timeout: Fulfillment has not progressed within the configured limit
vocabulary_operator_progress_within_wind: Fulfillment is still within its progress window
vocabulary_operator_no_remaining_work: There is no fulfillment work left
vocabulary_operator_explicit_exemption: This fulfillment is exempt from delay detection
vocabulary_operator_unknown_eligibility: Luma cannot yet confirm whether this fulfillment should progress
vocabulary_operator_unknown_progress: The last fulfillment progress is unknown
vocabulary_operator_unknown_status: The source has not reported a usable status
vocabulary_operator_unmapped_fulfillment: The fulfillment records need to be linked
vocabulary_operator_invalid_quantity: The source reported an invalid quantity
vocabulary_operator_unmapped_sku: The product variants need to be linked
vocabulary_operator_incomparable_pool: These sources refer to different stock pools
vocabulary_operator_incomparable_basis: These sources calculate available stock differently
vocabulary_operator_observation_skew: The source reads are too far apart to compare
vocabulary_operator_future_evidence: The source read time is ahead of Luma’s clock
vocabulary_operator_ambiguous_projection: Luma cannot confirm that the latest source read is represented
vocabulary_operator_terminal_failure: The workflow stopped after a failure
vocabulary_operator_retry_pending: The workflow is waiting to retry
vocabulary_operator_missing_durable_evid: The workflow has no saved evidence for this result
vocabulary_operator_reconciliation_requi: A fresh read is needed to confirm the uncertain change
vocabulary_operator_unknown_value: A source has not reported this value
vocabulary_operator_reads_not_current: Luma’s own stock reads are behind
vocabulary_operator_below_stall_threshol: Too few products are behind to call the sync stalled
vocabulary_operator_storefront_following: Most recent stock changes reached the store
vocabulary_operator_storefront_not_follo: The store stopped following stock changes
vocabulary_operator_sync_stalled: Waiting for the stalled stock sync
vocabulary_operator_authentication: The provider rejected the connection credentials
vocabulary_operator_permission_denied: The connection does not have access to these records
vocabulary_operator_invalid_response: The provider returned a response Luma could not read
vocabulary_operator_unsupported_capabili: The provider does not support this read
vocabulary_operator_unsupported_version: The provider does not support this capability version
vocabulary_operator_timeout: The provider did not answer in time
vocabulary_operator_rate_limited: The provider asked Luma to wait before retrying
vocabulary_operator_internal: Luma could not complete this read
vocabulary_operator_invalid_input: The provider could not accept this read request
vocabulary_operator_not_found: The requested source record was not found
vocabulary_operator_conflict: The source changed during this read
